items.title: On a regular scheme of dimension at most two a coherent module is reflexive exactly when it is finite locally free
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that on a regular scheme of dimension at most two, a coherent module is reflexive if and only if it is finite locally free (statement lines 2336-2345). The counted proof is a short case analysis by the dimension of the local ring at a point: a field in dimension zero, a discrete valuation ring in dimension one where reflexivity gives torsion freeness and torsion free finite modules are free, and a regular local ring of dimension two where reflexivity gives depth at least two and a maximal Cohen-Macaulay module over a regular local ring is free (proof lines 2347-2367). It is H2: the reduction and all three cases are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard facts about local rings of small dimension.
